headline: Iranian state-linked hackers use Windows malware against dissidents
summary: Two outlets report that Iranian state-linked hackers are using a Windows malware strain called CHOSEN BRICK to steal data from targets. One attributes the report to government agency warnings and names dissidents, activists and journalists as the targets; the other describes them only as enemies of the regime.
